description: Data layer + ORS integration core. Authors migration 014 (home location on profiles + suggested_routes cache), updates hand-maintained DB types, and builds the deterministic ORS layer under app/src/lib/integrations/ors/ (config, pure geo helpers, HTTP client with sentinel errors, error mapping, and the suggestRoute/resolveStart service) with full unit + mocked-integration tests. This is the foundation both other features depend on. Independent of FEAT-002/003 but must land first.
steps: Author supabase/migrations/014_route_suggestions.sql (DO NOT RUN — gotcha #4). Add nullable home_lat/home_lng (double precision) + home_label (text) to public.profiles (already owner-RLS'd; no new policy). Create public.suggested_routes per design.md: id uuid PK default gen_random_uuid(); user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE; planned_session_id uuid REFERENCES public.planned_sessions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL; requested_distance_m/distance_m/ascent_m/descent_m integer NOT NULL; terrain text NOT NULL CHECK (terrain IN ('flat','uphill')); start_lat/start_lng double precision NOT NULL; start_label text; geometry/elevation_profile/bbox jsonb NOT NULL; created_at/updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(). Enable RLS; copy the four owner-scoped SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies from 011_strava.sql (DROP POLICY IF EXISTS then CREATE POLICY ... auth.uid() = user_id). Add set_updated_at trigger. Add indexes suggested_routes_user_idx (user_id, created_at DESC) and suggested_routes_session_idx (planned_session_id). Idempotent (IF NOT EXISTS / DROP POLICY IF EXISTS).

Update app/src/types/database.ts: add home_lat (number|null), home_lng (number|null), home_label (string|null) to profiles Row/Insert/Update in _Database AND to the exported Profile interface. Add a suggested_routes table typing to _Database and an exported SuggestedRoute interface (geometry/elevation_profile/bbox typed as Json). Keep Database = any.

Create app/src/lib/integrations/ors/config.ts: read ORS_BASE_URL (default 'https://api.openrouteservice.org') + ORS_API_KEY from process.env (server-only); export ORS_TIMEOUT_MS (e.g. 8000) and MAX_SEEDS = 3.

Create app/src/lib/integrations/ors/geo.ts (all pure): fromGeolocation(pos) -> [lng,lat] (lat-first -> lng-first boundary; accept a GeolocationPosition-shaped {coords:{latitude,longitude}}); bboxOf(coords: [number,number][]|[number,number,number][]) -> [minLng,minLat,maxLng,maxLat]; sampleElevationProfile(coords3d: [number,number,number][], maxPoints=100) -> {distM,eleM}[] (cumulative planar/haversine distance ok); terrainScore(feature) -> ascentM (read ORS properties.summary.ascent / properties.ascent).

Create app/src/lib/integrations/ors/client.ts mirroring strava/client.ts. Export sentinel string consts ORS_RATE_LIMITED (429), ORS_UNAUTHORIZED (401/403), ORS_NO_ROUTE (404/no routable path), ORS_TIMEOUT, ORS_UNAVAILABLE (5xx/network). classifyOrsError(status, body) -> Error|null. orsRoundTrip({lng,lat,lengthM,seed,signal}) -> OrsRouteFeature: POST {ORS_BASE_URL}/v2/directions/foot-walking/geojson, body {coordinates:[[lng,lat]], options:{round_trip:{length:lengthM,points:4,seed}}, elevation:true, instructions:false}, header Authorization: ORS_API_KEY; wrap in AbortController with ORS_TIMEOUT_MS -> ORS_TIMEOUT; map non-OK via classifyOrsError. orsGeocode(text, signal) -> {lng,lat,label}|null: GET {ORS_BASE_URL}/geocode/search?text=...; zero/ambiguous -> null; degrade cleanly if geocode module absent. NEVER log the key or raw coordinates in plaintext.

Create app/src/lib/integrations/ors/errors.ts: orsErrorResponse(err) -> {status,message} mirroring stravaErrorResponse. Map ORS_RATE_LIMITED->429, ORS_UNAUTHORIZED->500 (owner-fixable 'set the ORS key'), ORS_NO_ROUTE->422 ('try a different distance/start'), ORS_TIMEOUT->504/503, ORS_UNAVAILABLE->502/503, NO_LOCATION->422 ('ask for a location'); fallback 500.

Create app/src/lib/integrations/ors/suggest.ts: export type Terrain='flat'|'uphill'; SuggestRouteOptions {distanceKm, terrain, coord?, placeText?, browserCoord?, plannedSessionId?}; RouteResult {routeId, requestedDistanceM, distanceM, ascentM, descentM, terrain, bbox, geometry (GeoJSON LineString), elevationProfile, start:{lng,lat,label}}; NO_LOCATION sentinel const. resolveStart(supabase,userId,opts) priority chain: explicit coord -> placeText via orsGeocode -> browserCoord -> profile home_lat/home_lng/home_label -> latest activity_streams stream_type='latlng' first point; throw NO_LOCATION when none. suggestRoute(supabase,userId,opts): resolveStart -> loop <=MAX_SEEDS orsRoundTrip -> select by terrain (flat=min terrainScore, uphill=max) -> normalise to RouteResult (incl requested vs actual) -> persist ONE suggested_routes row AFTER a valid route is chosen (set planned_session_id when attaching) -> return {...RouteResult, routeId}. Bounded timeout, graceful failure, never a partial row. Supabase client is passed in (type from @/lib/supabase/server usage); do NOT instantiate.

Add tests (Vitest, offline, stubbed Supabase per splits.test.ts): app/src/lib/integrations/ors/geo.test.ts (fromGeolocation lat->lng swap, bboxOf, sampleElevationProfile, terrainScore + terrain selection flat=min/uphill=max); app/src/lib/integrations/ors/errors.test.ts (classifyOrsError status mapping + orsErrorResponse status/message, mirror strava errors.test.ts); app/src/lib/integrations/ors/suggest.test.ts (resolveStart priority chain incl NO_LOCATION; integration with mocked global fetch — happy path writes ONE normalised suggested_routes row, ORS_NO_ROUTE/timeout writes nothing + surfaces sentinel, attach sets planned_session_id).
acceptance_criteria: supabase/migrations/014_route_suggestions.sql exists, is idempotent, has 4 CREATE POLICY statements, a set_updated_at trigger, both indexes, and the ON DELETE SET NULL session FK. It is NOT applied to any DB.
app/src/types/database.ts compiles with home_lat/home_lng/home_label on Profile and a SuggestedRoute interface.

ors/client.ts exports all five sentinels + classifyOrsError + orsRoundTrip + orsGeocode; ors/errors.ts exports orsErrorResponse; ors/suggest.ts exports suggestRoute, resolveStart, NO_LOCATION, and the types.
Running `cd app && npm run build` passes (TS check).
Running `cd app && npm run test` passes all new ORS unit + integration tests, including the flat=min/uphill=max selection and the NO_LOCATION path.
findings:
DONE. Build + all 64 tests pass (33 new ORS tests); grep CREATE POLICY = 4; eslint clean on ors/. NOTE: worktree had no node_modules — ran `npm install` in app/ once (maplibre-gl NOT needed for FEAT-001, defer its install to the UI features). Node 20 prints harmless @supabase deprecation warnings during build.

=== EXPORTS later features MUST use ===
All under `@/lib/integrations/ors/`.

config.ts: `ORS_BASE_URL: string`, `getOrsApiKey(): string|null`, `ORS_TIMEOUT_MS=8000`, `MAX_SEEDS=3`.

geo.ts (pure): `fromGeolocation(pos:{coords:{latitude,longitude}}): [lng,lat]` — THE lat→lng boundary (use for navigator.geolocation before passing browserCoord). `bboxOf(coords): [minLng,minLat,maxLng,maxLat]`. `sampleElevationProfile(coords3d,maxPoints=100): {distM,eleM}[]`. `terrainScore(feature): number`. Types: `interface LineString {type:'LineString';coordinates:number[][]}`, `interface OrsRouteFeature`, `interface GeolocationLike`.

client.ts (SERVER-ONLY): sentinels `ORS_RATE_LIMITED`,`ORS_UNAUTHORIZED`,`ORS_NO_ROUTE`,`ORS_TIMEOUT`,`ORS_UNAVAILABLE` (string consts). `classifyOrsError(status:number,body:string): Error|null`. `orsRoundTrip({lng,lat,lengthM,seed,signal?}): Promise<OrsRouteFeature>`. `orsGeocode(text,signal?): Promise<{lng,lat,label}|null>`. Key sent via Authorization header only (never query param / log).

errors.ts: `orsErrorResponse(err): {status,message}` — NO_LOCATION→422, ORS_NO_ROUTE→422, ORS_RATE_LIMITED→429, ORS_UNAUTHORIZED→500(owner-fixable), ORS_TIMEOUT→504, ORS_UNAVAILABLE→502, fallback 500.

suggest.ts: `NO_LOCATION` sentinel const. `type Terrain='flat'|'uphill'`. `interface SuggestRouteOptions {distanceKm:number; terrain:Terrain; coord?:{lng,lat}|null; placeText?:string|null; browserCoord?:{lng,lat}|null; plannedSessionId?:string|null}`. `interface RouteResult {routeId:string; requestedDistanceM:number; distanceM:number; ascentM:number; descentM:number; terrain:Terrain; bbox:[number,number,number,number]; geometry:LineString; elevationProfile:{distM,eleM}[]; start:{lng,lat,label:string|null}}`. `interface ResolvedStart {lng,lat,label:string|null}`. `resolveStart(supabase,userId,opts): Promise<ResolvedStart>` (throws Error(NO_LOCATION)). `suggestRoute(supabase,userId,opts): Promise<RouteResult>` — resolves start, tries ≤MAX_SEEDS seeds, flat=min/uphill=max ascent, persists ONE suggested_routes row AFTER selection, returns {...RouteResult,routeId}. Supabase client (SupabaseClient<Database> from @supabase/supabase-js) is PASSED IN; chat/API caller: `const supabase = await createClient()` (or createAdminClient) from @/lib/supabase/server.

IMPORTANT for the chat tool (gotcha #36): suggestRoute THROWS NO_LOCATION/ORS_* sentinels — the tool's execute() MUST catch and return a structured {needsLocation:true,message} / {error} object, never let it throw into the stream. Clamp distanceKm in execute (schema stays nullable+default).

=== DB (migration 014_route_suggestions.sql, NOT applied) ===
profiles: added nullable home_lat (double precision), home_lng (double precision), home_label (text). Mirrored onto exported `Profile` interface + `_Database` profiles Row/Insert/Update in types/database.ts.
New table public.suggested_routes columns: id uuid PK, user_id uuid, planned_session_id uuid (FK planned_sessions ON DELETE SET NULL), requested_distance_m int, distance_m int, ascent_m int, descent_m int, terrain text CHECK flat|uphill, start_lat double precision, start_lng double precision, start_label text, geometry jsonb, elevation_profile jsonb, bbox jsonb, created_at timestamptz, updated_at timestamptz. Exported `SuggestedRoute` interface + `RouteTerrain='flat'|'uphill'` type added to types/database.ts. RLS owner-scoped (4 policies), set_updated_at trigger, indexes suggested_routes_user_idx + suggested_routes_session_idx. Must be applied MANUALLY (gotcha #4) before runtime use.
